operating_notes.text: RPSG Ventures agreed to sell 5,810 CCPS each in Incnut Digital (₹11.76 Cr), Momjunction (₹0.61 Cr) and Incnut Stylecraze (₹0.15 Cr) to three individual buyers, total ₹12.52 Cr.

FY26 exceptional items of ₹100.50 Cr include ₹93.62 Cr for new labour codes effective 21 November 2025, ₹8.79 Cr associate impairment, ₹24.36 Cr contingent-consideration fair value adjustment and ₹22.45 Cr intangible impairment.
Sports segment result before tax and finance cost swung to -₹84.73 Cr in Q4FY26 from ₹23.93 Cr in Q4FY25; the filing says sports profits do not accrue evenly over the year.
Bowlopedia Restaurants India Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary, received an NCLT dissolution order dated 13 May 2026 after voluntary liquidation.

RPSG Ventures completed the sale of its entire CCPS investment in Momjunction Private Limited and Incnut Stylecraze Private Limited under the May 7, 2026 SPAs; the May 7 annexure listed ₹0.61 Cr for Momjunction and ₹0.15 Cr for Incnut Style

timeline.summary: RPSG Ventures incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary named RPSG Brands Mena Private Limited for FMCG trading.

RPSG Ventures signed three share purchase agreements on 7 May 2026 to sell its entire CCPS investment in Incnut Digital, Momjunction and Incnut Stylecraze to three individual buyers for a total ₹12.52 Cr.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,927.03 Cr (+15.2% YoY), net loss to shareholders ₹57.5 Cr (against a loss of ₹13.11 Cr a year earlier).
RPSG Ventures signed three SPAs on 7 May 2026 to sell its entire CCPS investment in Incnut Digital, Momjunction and Incnut Stylecraze to three individual buyers for a total ₹12.52 Cr.
RPSG Ventures completed the sale of its entire investment in Momjunction Private Limited and Incnut Stylecraze Private Limited under the May 7, 2026 share purchase agreements.
